proposals.risk: a result its requirement or criteria name is computed or chosen wrongly
proposals.rationale: Permanent (non-retryable) provider failures get an extra 'last chance' provider call after the retry loop, so they produce two provider interactions instead of exactly one.

proposals.risk: a result its requirement or criteria name is computed or chosen wrongly
proposals.rationale: Provider errors are converted to boundary errors inside the retry attempt, so the retry machinery sees a wrapped, non-transient error and never retries retryable status/transport failures on the same route.

proposals.risk: one input partition its requirement or criteria name is no longer handled as they say
proposals.rationale: Removing the retry loop completely, bypassing the retry mechanism for transient errors.

proposals.risk: one input partition its requirement or criteria name is no longer handled as they say
proposals.rationale: Omitting the 'with attempt:' context manager inside the tenacity loop, which prevents the retry library from catching and handling exceptions for retries.

proposals.risk: an external interaction its requirement rules out happens anyway
proposals.rationale: Permanent (non-retryable) provider failures trigger an extra 'last chance' adapter.execute call after the retry loop, causing a second provider interaction.

proposals.risk: an external interaction its requirement rules out happens anyway
proposals.rationale: The whole retrying loop is re-run with a fresh retry controller when the error is not classified retryable, so permanent failures are re-sent to the provider and retried as if transient.

proposals.risk: an error the interface must report comes out with the wrong type or status, or not at all
proposals.rationale: Exceptions are no longer converted through _provider_boundary_error: the raw provider exception is re-raised, so callers get the wrong error type/status for provider failures.

proposals.risk: an error the interface must report comes out with the wrong type or status, or not at all
proposals.rationale: Errors are swallowed when the retry loop ends without a result: on exception in a non-retryable case the function falls through and returns None-like/raises generic RuntimeError instead of the mapped boundary error, hiding permanent failures with the wrong type.
